findings.evidence: AST cannot prove exact-once behavior; successor must map producers, retries, ledgers and unique constraints.

limitations: Static AST findings are candidates, not confirmed defects.
Exact-once, retry and cross-function transaction behavior require successor runtime-shaped tests.
No gameplay, balance or user-facing policy conclusion is made in this audit.
